Windows agent for HomeyDeck. Setup guide: [README](https://github.com/OunissiDhiaEddine/HomeyDeck#setup).

To install: open HomeyDeck in a browser on the PC, go to **Settings → Set up this PC → Copy setup code**, then double-click `homeydeck-agent.exe` and click **Yes**.

To remove: Windows **Settings → Apps → HomeyDeck agent → Uninstall**, or double-click `homeydeck-agent.exe` again. Either way it deletes everything it saved.
